say:1:1430211501:1.text: You have no idea! I've been missing the taste of home since I entered the royal city. Nothing beats food from the commoners' district!
say:1:1430211501:1.source_cn: 好吃！我在王城时就一直怀念着平民区的味道，终于吃到了！

say:2:1430211502:1.text: Compared to the beautiful but bland-tasting palace food, I can only say that my taste buds aren't refined enough for courtly dishes.
say:2:1430211502:1.source_cn: 比起王城贵族们好看却没什么味道的宫廷菜，我的评价是，不...
